title: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3: Local Government in Urban Areas

topics.title: Participatory democracy and the levels of governance

concepts.learning_objective: Explain participatory democracy as citizens actively taking part in governance at every level.
Identify the rural and urban sides of the local level in India's pyramid of governance.

topics.title: Urban local bodies and ward committees

concepts.learning_objective: Explain what urban local bodies are and why they are called decentralised.
Describe how cities are divided into wards and what ward committees do.

topics.title: Functions and funding of urban local bodies

concepts.learning_objective: List the main functions and services of urban local bodies.
Explain how urban local bodies raise money through taxes, fines and charges.
Recall the origins of the Madras Corporation as India's oldest municipal institution.

topics.title: Types of urban local bodies
topics.ncert_sections: Urban Local Bodies (Municipal Corporation, Municipal Council, Nagar Panchayat)

concepts.learning_objective: Classify an urban local body as a Municipal Corporation, Municipal Council or Nagar Panchayat by population.

topics.title: Duties of citizens in urban areas
topics.ncert_sections: Urban Local Bodies; Before we move on

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how citizens' care for their area helps local bodies work efficiently.
Apply the idea of responsible citizenship to everyday civic problems.

topics.title: Village and city: comparing local democracy

concepts.learning_objective: Compare the Panchayati Raj system and urban local bodies.
Explain why everyone's voice matters in local democracy, in villages and cities alike.
